brand_identity.name: TORQUEHAUS — Auto Atelier
brand_identity.vibe: Dark cinematic garage aesthetic, high-performance automotive craftsmanship, tactical minimalism, luxury atelier atmosphere
brand_identity.target_audience: Exotic car owners, high-performance auto enthusiasts, luxury car drivers seeking bespoke maintenance, performance tuning, and master detailing

font_hierarchy.hero_h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase leading-[0.9]
font_hierarchy.section_h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase text-slate-100
font_hierarchy.card_h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-100
font_hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-400 font-normal leading-relaxed
font_hierarchy.mono_label: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-red-500 font-semibold

layout_system.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Section paddings: py-20 to py-32. Container max-width: max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layout_system.border_rules: Use 1px borders with dark tinted colors ('border-[#2A2F38]'). Cards must use internal padding 'p-6 md:p-8' to prevent content collisions.

motion_language.scroll_behavior: Lenis smooth scrolling for luxury editorial momentum
motion_language.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion y-axis slide from 100% to 0% overflow-hidden wrappers
motion_language.hover_effects: Card lift translateY(-4px), subtle red border highlight transition (duration 250ms), image zoom scale-105 transition ease-out
motion_language.marquee: Slow drifting infinite horizontal marquee using react-fast-marquee or framer-motion for brand ethos and stats

component_guidelines.header_nav: Sticky glassmorphism navigation header with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#090A0C]/80 border-b border-[#2A2F38]. Includes logo, nav items (Services, Atelier, Booking, Contact), Admin access button, and 'Book Appointment' primary CTA.
component_guidelines.hero_section: Dark cinematic hero with spotlight image overlay. Overlay gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-t from-[#090A0C] via-[#090A0C]/70 to-transparent'. Feature kinetic typography with staggered reveal lines, stats counter bento badge, and direct trigger for online booking modal/section.
component_guidelines.services_showcase: Asymmetrical 12-column Bento Grid showcasing 5 core services: 1. ECU Diagnostics & Tuning (Hero Card col-span-8), 2. Master Engine Overhaul (col-span-4), 3. High Performance Braking & Suspension (col-span-4), 4. Bespoke Ceramic Detailing (col-span-4), 5. Precision Wheel Alignment & Tires (col-span-4). Includes interactive filter and modal detail views.
component_guidelines.appointment_booking: Interactive multi-step online booking workflow: Step 1 (Select Service & Package), Step 2 (Pick Preferred Date & Time Slot), Step 3 (Vehicle Specs: Make, Model, Year, Mileage, Vin/Notes), Step 4 (Customer Details & Instant Confirmation with Reference ID). Saves directly to backend/localStorage.
component_guidelines.enquiry_form: Sleek contact form with fields for Name, Email, Phone, Vehicle Details, and Message. Submissions saved to admin database with instant status feedback using Sonner toast.
component_guidelines.marquee_banner: Slow moving editorial marquee with high-contrast text and stats: 'PRECISION TUNING /// MASTER DETAILING /// GERMAN & ITALIAN EXOTICS /// CERTIFIED ATELIER TECHNICIANS /// Bespoke Service since 2018'.
component_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Protected admin portal with simulated login (Username: admin, Pass: torque2026). Features 3 core tabs: 1. Bookings Management (filter by status, confirm/cancel, view vehicle info), 2. Enquiries Inbox (mark read, respond status), 3. Services Manager (edit price, status, duration). Uses dense dashboard grid with statistics metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Implement smooth animations with Framer Motion and Sonner for toasts. Do not use Inter or generic default fonts. Maintain high dark-mode contrast with kinetic red highlights (#FF3333).
